# netbox_circuit_termination (Data Source)

Retrieves a single circuit termination from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_circuit_termination" "example" {
  id         = 1
  circuit_id = 1
}

output "circuit_termination_id" {
  value = data.netbox_circuit_termination.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cable_id` (Number) The ID of the cable associated with the circuit termination.
- `circuit_id` (Number) The ID of the circuit associated with the circuit termination.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the circuit termination.
- `port_speed` (Number) The port speed of the circuit termination.
- `pp_info` (String) The pp info of the circuit termination.
- `termination_type` (String) The termination type of the circuit termination.
- `upstream_speed` (Number) The upstream speed of the circuit termination.

### Read-Only

- `cable_end` (String) The cable end of the circuit termination.
- `created` (String) The created of the circuit termination.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the circuit termination, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the circuit termination.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the circuit termination.
- `link_peers_type` (String) The link peers type of the circuit termination.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) The mark connected of the circuit termination.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `term_side` (String) The term side of the circuit termination.
- `termination` (String) The termination of the circuit termination.
- `termination_id` (Number) The termination id of the circuit termination.
- `xconnect_id` (String) The xconnect id of the circuit termination.
